applicationStart: cd code_deploy_application && npm install && npm run build && { nohup npm run preview -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 --strictPort >> /root/application.log 2>&1 & APP_PID=$!; echo "$APP_PID" > /root/application.pid; sleep 2; kill -0 "$APP_PID"; }
applicationStop: if [ -f /root/application.pid ]; then kill "$(cat /root/application.pid)" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f /root/application.pid; fi
